summary: V3R1_LOCAL_CHAIN_IMPLEMENTATION_READY. The bounded eleven-file versioned cutover now joins the already deployed V3R1 create-only exporter contract to fixed transfer, receipt, diagnostic and terminal interpretation entry points. The V3R1 validator binds the exact thirty-file package, canonical manifest and seal, task/source/generation lineage, selected fourteen-day streak, full calendar and selected-streak heads, missingness disclosures, source release, bundle/envelope hashes and source roots. Only the fourteen selected complete days reach the unchanged diagnostic analyzer; rejected days and nonselected prefixes remain disclosure-only. The receiver preflights archive metadata and allowlists before create-once publication. The terminal interpretation runner reuses the unchanged simplest-first evaluator and stops before hypothesis design or the positive economic route. The active-chain verifier now recognizes exactly the three V3R1 stages and proves exporter-to-Local authority equality with byte-identical VALID output under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7. Five focused tests and seventy-four frozen affected tests pass. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero. Live evidence transfer, fourteen-day completion, prediction, fees, slippage, capacity, candidate readiness, OOS, deployment and activation remain MISSING_PROOF.
